notes.title: HotFix May/08
notes.notes:
Fixed problem with first boss fight.
Fixed animation problems with running weapons.

notes.title: First Hotfix!
notes.notes:
A lot of ammunition at the beginning of the game.
Now enemies also drop ammo.
Reduced enemies HP.
Increased damage from the last hit combo.
Fixed bug to equip the weapon the first time.
The player’s camera is a little higher.
